content.comment_body: Is it possible to send basic on/off signals from [product_name] [version_no] to another [product_name] [version_no] over the network? I have found a method to share this data between [product_name] [version_no] devices, but not yet between [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no]. The setup is for controlling lights in our home, using a master off button. I would like to connect the momentary button to just one [product_name] [version_no], then distribute a reset signal to the other [product_name] [version_no] devices, including this one [product_name] [version_no]. All devices are on the same network, so connectivity is not an issue.

Yes, this can be done, though it's not as straightforward as communication between two [article_no]. Do you want to transmit bits from [article_no] to [article_no], or vice versa? Let us know how many bits you need to send and in which direction, and I can prepare an example for you.

Two bits sent from [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [version_no] should be sufficient for now. Specifically, these will be 'reset' and 'enable' signals. One bit is enough, but two would be ideal. Currently, there is no need to send data from [version_no] to [version_no].
Here's a sample for exchanging two bits between [article_no] and [article_no].
Thank you, this turned out to be much simpler than I expected.

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed how to transmit control bits over a network between different versions of [product_name] modules. While communication between same-version devices is straightforward, sending signals between different versions was initially believed to be more complex. Community support provided an example that demonstrated this process is possible and less complicated than anticipated, though it's slightly less direct compared to same-version communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect efficient and easy network communication for control signals between varying module versions, focusing on transmission from newer to older versions, with minimal setup difficulty.
